purpose: Rat->human one-to-one ortholog map over the Open TG-GATEs matrix columns, needed for a target-free (rat-side) responsive-gene panel. No such map existed in the repository.

queries.rat_ensembl_to_entrez: <?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><!DOCTYPE Query><Query virtualSchemaName="default" formatter="TSV" header="0" uniqueRows="1" count="" datasetConfigVersion="0.6"><Dataset name="rnorvegicus_gene_ensembl" interface="default"><Attribute name="ensembl_gene_id"/><Attribute name="entrezgene_id"/></Dataset></Query>
queries.rat_to_human_homology: <?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><!DOCTYPE Query><Query virtualSchemaName="default" formatter="TSV" header="0" uniqueRows="1" count="" datasetConfigVersion="0.6"><Dataset name="rnorvegicus_gene_ensembl" interface="default"><Attribute name="ensembl_gene_id"/><Attribute name="hsapiens_homolog_ensembl_gene"/><Attribute name="hsapiens_homolog_orthology_type"/><Attribute name="hsapiens_homolog_orthology_confidence"/></Dataset></Query>
queries.human_ensembl_to_entrez: <?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><!DOCTYPE Query><Query virtualSchemaName="default" formatter="TSV" header="0" uniqueRows="1" count="" datasetConfigVersion="0.6"><Dataset name="hsapiens_gene_ensembl" interface="default"><Attribute name="ensembl_gene_id"/><Attribute name="entrezgene_id"/></Dataset></Query>

filters: hsapiens_homolog_orthology_type == ortholog_one2one AND hsapiens_homolog_orthology_confidence == 1; then the Entrez-level pair must be unique in both directions among the matrix columns
